oracle_precedence: missing consent/IRB state triggers insufficient-evidence escalation

augmentation_rationale: Gate 22B/22C demonstrated that atomic templates alone can underrepresent rule interactions. Research/IRB augmentation therefore adds interaction-rich non-OOD states before considering a more complex model.
anti_leakage: all Gate-23 OOD core signatures excluded from augmentation
